definitions.explanation: To think about something again and possibly change one's mind or perspective on it.

definitions.gloss: to recall, to look back on, to reflect on
definitions.explanation: To bring past events or memories to mind and think about them again.

examples.japanese: ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{思|おも}い{返|かえ}してみた。
⟦{冷静|れいせい}→冷静：03781_reisei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{思|おも}い{返|かえ}せば、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: Thinking it over calmly, I can understand what he's saying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧{思|おも}い{返|かえ}して⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{恥|は}ずかしい→恥ずかしい：00843_hazukashii⟧。
examples.english: Even now when I recall it, I feel embarrassed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{返|かえ}す。
examples.english: To look back on one's student days.
When I recall that day, tears come to my eyes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{返|かえ}して⟦{反省|はんせい}する→反省する：21398_hanseisuru⟧。
examples.english: To reflect on the past and learn from one's mistakes.

notes:
{思|おも}い{返|かえ}す combines ⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ (to think) with ⟦{返|かえ}す→返す：09648_kaesu⟧ (to return), conveying the sense of returning to past thoughts or reconsidering.

Usage patterns:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{返|かえ}す (to recall/reconsider something)
- ⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧{思|おも}い{返|かえ}して⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ (even now when I think back)
- ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧{思|おも}い{返|かえ}してみる (to think it over carefully)

Transitivity: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
Conjugation: ⟦{五段|ごだん}→五段：28275_godan⟧ (godan/u-verb)

Related words:
- ⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧: to remember, recall (more spontaneous)
- ⟦{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る→振り返る：04231_furikaeru⟧: to look back on, reflect
- ⟦{考|かんが}え{直|なお}す→考え直す：04591_kangaenaosu⟧: to reconsider, think again
